card.name: Article before a person's description
card.fires_on: The words a or an (sometimes the) right after a person's name, when the text is about to describe who they are, such as their job, origin or role. Mostly in news or bio text.

modes.label: Appositive after a name
modes.description: A or an after a comma following a person's name, starting a description of them.
modes.example: Youngstown manager Marty Hogan,<< a>> former outfielder, was an outstanding judge

modes.label: Is a / is an in bios
modes.description: A or an after 'is' in a short biography line, before a job or title.
modes.example: Marya Washington Tyler is<< a>> gifted child consultant in Ketchikan,

modes.label: Sentence-initial A/An after a name
modes.description: A capitalized A or An starting a sentence right after a person's name, introducing their origin.
modes.example: John Bradley.<< An>> Appleton native and graduate of Appleton

card.writes: It favors words like native and active, which fit a description of where a person is from or what they do.
card.plain: It fires on the little word 'a' or 'an' that introduces who a named person is, such as 'a native of' or 'an educator'.
